name: Drayton Hall
scope: The standing main house at Drayton Hall near Charleston as photographed in 2008, including the land-side double portico, raised terrace, red roof and river-side entrance.

originalReview.notes: The April 2008 view from southwest shows the red roof, the four pale portico columns, the raised entry terrace, the white window frames and the brick exterior. The survey controls the elevations outside the photo.

review.method: Exact Qualla original with the photographer’s first-revision public-domain grant
review.notes: The original file release and sole upload are by the same Commons account. The photograph’s maker identifies it as own work and releases it into the public domain. The exact local Qualla bytes match the uploaded photo and the April 2008 camera date.
